settings.title: Preferences
settings.launchOnStartupHint: Starts OTX.GNG minimized to the tray when you sign in.
settings.minimizeToTrayHint: Closing the window keeps OTX.GNG running in the tray so Game Mode can react to games.
settings.alertOnStart: Alert when a connection or Game Mode starts
settings.realtimeHint: Re-checks priorities and memory every few seconds during a session instead of only at game start.
settings.smartHint: Only applies a step when a measurement says it is needed, for example memory cleaning only under real pressure.
settings.dualRoutesHint: Sends game packets over two paths to one relay to hide packet loss. Needs a relay (Tier 2).
settings.dualRoutesDisabled: Add a relay in Community Servers to enable this.
settings.accuracyHint: Higher accuracy takes more samples before deciding, which is slower but more reliable.
settings.hardwareHint: Temperatures, clocks and fans. Off by default: CPU sensors need an optional driver.
settings.shortcutHint: Click, then press the new key combination. Esc cancels.
settings.redirectionHint: How game traffic is steered to a relay. Automatic picks the safest method for each game.
settings.winNetHint: Resets the TCP/IP stack, Winsock and the DNS cache. Your adapters reconnect.
settings.glassQualityHint: Auto turns glass off while a game runs and uses a lighter version on integrated GPUs or battery saver.
settings.telemetryHint: Off by default. v1 has no telemetry backend, so nothing is ever sent even when on.
settings.crashHint: Crash reports stay on this PC as a redacted file you can attach to a GitHub issue.
settings.simulateGame: Simulate a game in the foreground
settings.simulateGameHint: Phase 1 only. Tests glass auto-degrade, UI pausing and the live HUD without a real game.
